column7: Decides the sign-in form's own origin before POST /ui/signin reads its body: only the public_url origin when one is set (none when it does not parse), otherwise a loopback origin of the running listener on a loopback or wildcard bind.
Builds the loopback origins a listener answers to, shared by the origin guard's allowed list and the sign-in rule.
Decides whether the bind host is a wildcard, which lets the sign-in form admit the listener's loopback origins and the dashboard link open from loopback.
